It is unlayered: the only @layer block in the file is `@layer base` at 511-516. The comment at 508-510 says unlayered rules beat Tailwind's `@layer utilities`. ArchiveEntryGrid.tsx:42-58 renders ArchiveEntryCard as direct children of `.justified-grid`, and ArchiveEntryCard.tsx:116 gives the clickable cell `justified-grid-cell ... transition-colors hover:bg-bg-elevated`. So the archive cell's hover color transition becomes instant. ArchiveEntryGrid is not in the touch-point list.

specification_compliance: Touch-point drift is confirmed in three places: an unlayered CSS rule that also reaches the archive grid (F1), e2e registry files (F2), and different jsdom suites from the ones planned (F3).
